integrity: A reproducible rational outward-interval certificate supports the new robust coexistence claim. Publication priority requires further human literature verification; the numerical phenomenon is not newly discovered.
scientific_limitations: The certified open rectangle is deliberately small, not an optimal parameter domain. No global census of repelling periodic points, basins, or full differential-equation lifting is proved. Numerical maximal bistability and the at-most-two upper bound were previously known.
title: Certified open bistability rectangle for an exponential interval map
